title: 14-BCV-020 - Sprinkler systems with antifreeze solutions
jurisdiction: Alberta (province-wide, as stated by the STANDATA)
code_edition: Alberta Building Code 2014 and Alberta Fire Code 2014

facts.text: The joint 14-FCV-022/14-BCV-020 STANDATA concerns sprinkler freeze protection for buildings requiring systems under the cited 2014 codes and NFPA editions.

It permits existing systems to maintain their designed freeze-protection level and says concentrations must not be reduced without alternative freeze protection; new systems must be designed for a typical Alberta climate or use alternatives listed in the document.
